description: This Java source file defines the IdempotencyHelper class, providing utility methods for handling idempotency-related operations in the Fineract integration tests. It includes methods for converting business step data to/from JSON, fetching business step configurations from a server, and updating business step orders with consideration for idempotency.

classes.name: IdempotencyHelper
classes.description: A final class providing static helper methods for handling idempotency in Fineract integration tests, including conversion between JSON and Java objects, retrieving configurations, and updating business steps.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Serializes a list of BusinessStep objects into a JSON string wrapped in a BusinessStepWrapper.

methods.name: configuredBusinessStepFromJsonString
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a JobBusinessStepConfigData object.

methods.name: availableBusinessStepFromJsonString
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a JobBusinessStepDetail object.

methods.name: getConfiguredBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches configured business steps for a given job name from the server and deserializes the response.

methods.name: getAvailableBusinessStepsByJobName
methods.description: Fetches available business steps for a given job name from the server and deserializes the response.

methods.name: updateBusinessStepOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of business steps for a specified job on the server with a given JSON body, including an idempotency key.

methods.name: updateBusinessStepOrderWithError
methods.description: Performs an update to business step order that is expected to produce an error, including an idempotency key.
